title: Example panics 'Unhandled interrupt on ProCpu' on first HTTP request (hardware)
description: On classic ESP32 (rev v3.1), examples/esp32.rs boots, joins WiFi, gets DHCP IP, prints 'online at http://<ip>:8080/'. WiFi+DHCP (UDP) work. But the FIRST inbound TCP connection on :8080 triggers a panic: EspDefaultHandler at esp-hal-1.1.1/src/interrupt/mod.rs:75 -> 'Unhandled interrupt on ProCpu'. Backtrace decoded to picoserve serve future (select_either over the router incl events_handler/EventStream + REST handlers). Repro: flash esp32 example, curl http://<ip>:8080/release -> times out, serial shows PANIC. Init (esp_hal::init, esp_alloc heap reclaimed, TimerGroup TIMG0, SoftwareInterruptControl, esp_rtos::start(timg0.timer0, sw_int0)) matches the working sibling esp32-sensor-esp32-rust-dev, BUT that sibling uses BLE not the WiFi+embassy-net+picoserve TCP serve path. Suspect missing esp-radio 0.18 <-> esp-rtos 0.3 scheduler/interrupt integration or a missing interrupt handler binding for the serve path. Blocks esp-gpio-viewer-96w.

title: reader.rs digital reads + sampler.rs diff loop + /events SSE
description: Register-level GPIO input reads via esp-hal PAC (GPIO.in_ 0-31, in1 32+), non-invasive. Builder pin registry (.digital PinMode). embassy sampler task diffing at samplingInterval (100ms default), PubSubChannel to SSE clients. picoserve streaming /events emitting gpio-state (changed only), free_heap on change, 1000ms heartbeat, baseline pins on connect. Value mapping: digital s=256/0, v=0/1, t=0. Acceptance: live digital pins animate in UI.

title: picoserve router with all static REST endpoints
description: Router for GET / (index HTML with <base href=baseURL>, hosted asset tags, window.gpio_settings), /release, /sampling, /free_psram, /espinfo, /partition, /pinmodes, /pinfunctions. Stub/static data initially. Acceptance: hosted Vue UI loads in browser at http://<ip>:8080/.

title: Crate skeleton + protocol.rs serializers + host unit tests
description: Cargo.toml (esp32/esp32s3 features, deps: esp-hal, embassy-net/sync/time, picoserve, heapless, serde-json-core). src/lib.rs public types (GpioViewer, GpioViewerBuilder, PinMode). src/protocol.rs serializers emitting EXACT JSON/SSE shapes: /release {"release"}, /sampling {"sampling"}, quirky /free_psram, gpio-state {s,v,t} frame, pinmodes, pinfunctions, espinfo, partition. Host std test target asserting byte-for-byte output. Acceptance: cargo test passes on host.

title: Port GPIOViewer to native ESP32 Rust crate (esp-gpio-viewer)
description: no_std esp-hal + embassy-net + picoserve reimplementation of the GPIOViewer backend HTTP/SSE protocol. Reuses the remotely-hosted Vue UI. Full protocol parity. See .claude/plans/i-want-to-use-compressed-locket.md

title: On-device end-to-end verification + curl protocol spot-check
description: Flash example, join WiFi STA, open http://<ip>:8080/ -> hosted UI loads and shows live pins; toggle output pin -> tile animates; heap updates. curl -N /events eyeballs SSE frames; curl /release /sampling /pinmodes /pinfunctions match contract. Acceptance: all protocol endpoints verified against the C++ contract.

title: /espinfo + /partition real data, polish, per-chip examples
description: Real chip/flash/reset-reason/SDK-IDF info via esp-hal + PAC EFUSE. Partition table read. free_heap via esp-alloc stats, free_psram via psram feature. examples/ per chip (esp32, esp32s3) reusing wifi/embassy-net bootstrap from esp32-sensor-esp32-rust-dev and my-rv-monitoring-display-esp32s3. Acceptance: cargo build --features esp32 and --features esp32s3 both compile; example flashes and runs.

title: PWM (LEDC) and ADC reads — full pin-type parity
description: Builder .pwm(pin, channel, resolution_bits) and .adc(pin). PWM: read LEDC duty via esp-hal ledc/PAC, s=map(duty,0..maxDuty,0..255), t=1. ADC: shared Adc driver in sampler (documents required ownership), v=raw 0..4095, s=map(...,0..255), t=2. Wire into readGPIO-equivalent and pinfunctions ADC/Touch listing. Acceptance: PWM & analog pins report correct s/v/t.
